reason: Composer manifest contains unbound @dev dependencies, missing distribution metadata, and lacks .gitattributes export-ignore rules.
scope_checked: composer.json schema validation and version constraints

findings.title: Unbound @dev version constraints in composer.json require section
findings.description: composer.json specifies '@dev' for 'alex-kassel/laravel-domain-core', 'alex-kassel/stable-fingerprint', and 'roach-php/laravel'. Releasing a package to Packagist with @dev root requirements breaks SemVer resolution for downstream consumers.
findings.recommendation: Update dependency constraints to semantic version bounds (e.g., ^2.0 for domain-core and stable-fingerprint, and ^2.0 || ^3.0 for roach-php/laravel).

findings.title: Missing Packagist discovery metadata in composer.json (keywords, homepage, support)
findings.description: composer.json is missing keywords, homepage, and support links required for high-quality open-source distribution on Packagist.
findings.evidence: composer.json lacks keywords, homepage, and support blocks.
findings.recommendation: Populate keywords, homepage, and support links in composer.json.

findings.title: Missing .gitattributes with export-ignore rules for release archive build
findings.description: No .gitattributes file exists in packages/alex-local/scraper-core. When building a release zip via git archive, tests, build caches, and configuration files would leak into production consumer installations.
findings.evidence: File .gitattributes does not exist in package root.
findings.recommendation: Create .gitattributes with standard eol=lf and export-ignore for tests/, phpunit.xml, .phpunit.result.cache, etc.
